events.title: Rust 2024 edition released
events.summary: Rust 1.85 shipped the 2024 edition on February 20, 2025 — refining unsafe semantics, async closures, and match ergonomics.
events.about: The 2024 edition polishes Rust for systems programmers adopting async and embedded targets: clearer unsafe rules, `gen` blocks for generators, and smoother `cargo fix --edition` migrations. Rust continues expanding in Linux, WebAssembly, and infrastructure as memory-safe languages gain regulatory momentum.

narrative.whyChosen: The 2024 edition keeps Rust evolving without the breakage trauma of other languages.
narrative.whyImportant: Safer unsafe and async ergonomics matter as Rust moves into kernels and firmware.
narrative.problemSolved: Growing Rust codebases needed clearer rules around unsafe and edition migrations.
